scripts.setup: bash -c '([ -d node_modules/concurrently ] || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && ([ -d server/node_modules ] || npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund) && ([ -d client/node_modules ] || npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund) && ([ -d server/dist ] || npm --prefix server run build) && ([ -d client/dist ] || npm --prefix client run build)'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,AI" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix ai-service run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
